header: One-off costs of switching to Talbrunn
subheader: Charged in the month the work is done, and never again.
lead: None of these is required. If you migrate your own data and train your own team, you pay only the monthly price.
note: Prices exclude VAT and are invoiced in the month the work is done. Work outside 07:00–19:00 on working days costs 150%. Travel outside Vienna is €0.50 per kilometre.

fees.title: Data migration
fees.text: Patients, appointments, open invoices and scanned documents from your current system, checked against your record counts before go-live.

fees.title: On-site setup day
fees.text: One working day at your practice: workstations, printers, card terminal and support on site during your first live morning.

fees.title: Remote training, half day
fees.text: Four hours for the whole team. You keep the recording.

fees.title: Card-terminal configuration
fees.text: Per terminal, connected and tested with a real payment.

fees.title: Extra address set-up
fees.text: Rooms, opening hours and practitioners set up for one more treatment address.

fees.title: Template design
fees.text: Your letterhead, findings template and invoice layout rebuilt in Talbrunn. Per set of three documents.

fees.title: Export and handover on leaving
fees.text: Free, whenever you ask and for any reason. Your data belongs to you, so leaving costs nothing.
